introduction.text: Castello di Corcolle is a fortress east of Rome on Via Zagarolese, notable for its role as a transition fortress of the late 15th century and its association with prominent Roman families.

history.description: The castle was a transition fortress of the late 15th century, marking the emergence of modern fortifications.
The castle was owned by the Colonna, Barberini, and Orsini families.

design.description: The castle exemplifies a transition fortress design of the late 15th century, bridging medieval and modern fortification styles.
